title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web | TechCrunch
summary: Censys said that its data showed the Artex instance in question had been publicly exposed for months, and appeared to contain more attack data that extended “well beyond South Korean banks,” including payment and gaming companies.
